rows.targetSeam: server/src/index.ts; systemIntegration composition graph and application facade
rows.reason: AI runtime needs one lifecycle mount without creating a second Control Plane.
contract: Inject one killable non-critical managed port with typed start, stop, probe, bounded resources and AI-off semantics.
tests: Prove start, stop and probe failure paths plus boot, recovery and shutdown with AI and provider absent.
expectedBehavior: Core lifecycle remains unchanged when AI is absent or unavailable; no second lifecycle owner.

rows.targetSeam: productIntegration runtime router, service and types
rows.reason: AI reads and proposals need authenticated Product-plane ingress without a second API authority.
contract: Add bounded AI-Ops read, chat and proposal schemas behind existing operator middleware.
tests: Reject unauthenticated, malformed, oversized and mutation-bearing read or chat payloads.
expectedBehavior: Strict bounded responses preserve unknown and unavailable; reads cannot mutate canonical state.

rows.targetSeam: Ledger and existing systemIntegration/productIntegration persistence adapters
rows.reason: Durable AI records must use the sole canonical persistence owner.
contract: Add Ledger adapters for cases, transitions, inbox, outbox, DLQ, attempts, effects, usage, approvals, evidence hashes and retention pointers.
tests: Prove backup, restore, restart, replay, compare-and-set conflict and corrupt-record failure behavior.
expectedBehavior: Zero acknowledged authoritative-record loss; one Ledger; no second store or file journal.

rows.targetSeam: security OperatorAccess and server operator middleware
rows.reason: Human and worker principals require distinct default-deny scopes.
contract: Bind separately authenticated human owner and isolated worker principals to explicit role, tool and provider scopes using non-secret references.
tests: Prove deny-by-default, role separation, revocation and credential non-exposure with hostile cross-identity attempts.
expectedBehavior: No subscription credential reaches application, browser, model, repository or worker context; no inherited authority.

rows.targetSeam: shared package manifests, scripts and lockfile
rows.reason: Lane-local work cannot edit shared scripts, dependencies or lockfiles.
contract: Apply only dependency and script deltas named by sealed accepted lane receipts.
tests: Run lockfile integrity, offline tests, license, security and dependency-necessity checks.
expectedBehavior: Only reviewed packages and scripts land; no hidden network or provider calls.

rows.reason: Isolated worker and sentinel deployment plus AI-off gates belong to the release owner.
contract: Add owner-approved isolated service, worker and sentinel templates plus canary, rollback and AI-off gates.
tests: Validate with fake credentials and endpoints; prove canary, rollback, revocation and independent readback.
expectedBehavior: Prestage activates no provider; later deployment requires fresh owner approval and preserves core behavior with AI off.

rows.targetSeam: productAssurance remediation campaign and canonical command owner
rows.reason: Deterministic campaigns exist only as pure vocabulary and cannot silently become an executor.
contract: Ratify typed action requests, registered runbooks, durable checkpoints and existing-effect-owner bindings; never create an AI executor.
tests: Prove lease, fence, idempotency, precondition, postcondition, quiet period, checkpoint, restart and forbidden actions.
expectedBehavior: Effects run only through existing owners; money capabilities remain impossible.

rows.targetSeam: foundation observability, systemIntegration supervisor, runtime trace and assurance truth projection
rows.reason: AI queue, drop, lag, provider, case and resource facts need canonical health projection.
contract: Register bounded observations without a second telemetry or health authority.
tests: Inject missing, stale, future, dropped, saturated and provider-outage evidence; run core non-degradation soak.
expectedBehavior: Missing telemetry is MISSING or SILENT; authority downgrades; core stays within signed overhead budgets.

rows.targetSeam: test perimeter, private-egress tripwire and deployment network policy
rows.reason: Provider access, if ever approved, needs explicit allowlisting and non-secret injection.
contract: Admit only owner-approved endpoints through a credential proxy with endpoint, method, schema, role, budget and retention bounds.
tests: Keep unit tests network-free; hostile DNS, redirect, method and schema tests; prove exchange hosts remain denied.
expectedBehavior: No egress before owner activation; zero exchange connection; credentials never enter app, browser, model, repo or worker context.

rows.targetSeam: missing production owner and existing independent-sentinel projection
rows.reason: Evaluator vocabulary exists but no independently deployed sentinel owner is configured.
contract: Bind an external read-only sentinel in a separate failure domain with no trading or patch authority.
tests: Prove independent liveness, stale delivery, main-app outage and sentinel-outage fault cases.
expectedBehavior: Sentinel reports independently and fail-closed; it cannot execute, trade, patch or mint readiness.

rows.targetSeam: missing production owner, S6 retention contracts and canonical Ledger insertion seam
rows.reason: AI provenance requires independently administered append-only delivery distinct from worker execution.
contract: Ratify audit retention, delivery, readback, chain, hash and restoration through the Ledger owner.
tests: Prove append chain, tamper detection, delivery loss, expiry, restore and independent readback.
expectedBehavior: Audit loss is visible; no worker can rewrite or delete evidence or administer its audit sink.

rows.targetSeam: runtime managed identities, inventory and supervisor envelope
rows.reason: Mounted AI components need canonical inventory and supervisor truth.
contract: Insert only ratified AI identities, availability, blockers and posture into Product runtime projections.
tests: Prove absent, starting, healthy, degraded, unavailable and killed states with exact blocker propagation.
expectedBehavior: Cockpit receives canonical server truth; AI absence cannot degrade or falsify core readiness.

rows.targetSeam: missing generic approval owner; Product command preview/result are evidence only
rows.reason: Elevated AI proposals require separately authenticated human approval that no AI can satisfy.
contract: Ratify approval request and receipt binding artifact, parameters, expiry, principal, reauthentication and execution readback.
tests: Prove expiry, replay, substitution, AI-as-approver, inherited-chat and role-confusion failures.
expectedBehavior: Only authenticated human owner approves; preview is never approval; executor accepts only exact approved artifact.

rows.targetSeam: server config, environment example and I00 environment templates
rows.reason: Provider and worker configuration must be explicit, revocable and separate from secrets.
contract: Add ratified non-secret identity, provider, budget and endpoint bindings; secrets remain external references.
tests: Prove default NOT_CONFIGURED, invalid config rejection, redaction, round trip, deconfiguration and no-secret scans.
expectedBehavior: No provider call from defaults; no secret in repo, log or fixture; missing config remains honest.

rows.targetSeam: root test scripts, production-operation scan manifest denominator and I00 complete acceptance
rows.reason: Accepted lane gates and newly scanned production adapter paths need one canonical root acceptance mount.
contract: Register sealed lane tests, AI-off fault gates and the updated production-operation scanned-file denominator only after acceptance.
tests: Run focused lane, network-free root, complete acceptance, hostile false-green and exact exit-code gates.
expectedBehavior: Real failures return nonzero; no fake success; accepted counts and commands are canonical.
